bone headwear and practical tribal clothing reference

visual_inspection.headgear: Infantry has a small horned skull cap; thrower has a leather cap with bone forehead plate and tooth ornaments.
visual_inspection.clothing: Chest, abdomen, thighs and shins covered by leather jerkin, trousers, hip panels and wraps; blue faces, hands, upper-arm areas and toes visible.
visual_inspection.thrower: Both hands below waist; one holds a stone beside the thigh, the other hangs beside stone bag.
visual_inspection.limitations: Concept sheet only. Blade still has a tight left margin; off-white background has faint variation. Not a transparent atlas or final animation master.

user_visual_approval: rejected: user finds clothing too enclosing and recurring skull headgear, red scarves and layered leather too uniform; requests moderate differences in face, physique and costume design
